messages.author: 3651c4eb6da83745
messages.subject: Sweave and ggplot2 error
parts:
I'm using WinEdt with Sweave and can include a standard R 'plot',
however using a ggplot produces this error:

** Error in print(qplot(myvar, myvar, geom = "point")) :
** could not find function "qplot"

Please find sample code below. It includes the print() which others
have suggested, but the error remains.

Thanks for any assistance.
---------

\documentclass[a4paper]{article}
\begin{document}

This is a test of the Sweave package using WinEdt/TeX Live. First we
create a simple array:
<<>>=
myvar=c(1:10)
@

Then we plot it using the standard plot function of R:

\begin{center}
<<fig=TRUE,echo=FALSE>>=
plot(myvar)
@
\end{center}

Then we plot it using the qplot function of ggplot2:

\begin{center}
<<fig=TRUE,echo=FALSE>>=
print(qplot(myvar,myvar,geom="point"))
@
\end{center}


\end{document}

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Sweave and ggplot2 error
parts:
Looks to me like you forgot to load the ggplot2 library. Change the
second code chunk to

<<fig=TRUE,echo=FALSE>>=
library(ggplot2)
print(qplot(myvar,myvar,geom="point"))
@

-Ista
